cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
from scipy.optimize import minimize

smiles='[N-](CCP(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C)CCP(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles))
anchors={0:np.array([0.,-2.02,0.]),3:np.array([-2.38,-.31,0.]),14:np.array([2.38,-.31,0.])}
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3()
params.randomSeed=213
params.useRandomCoords=True
params.SetCoordMap({i:Point3D(*p) for i,p in anchors.items()})
params.numThreads=0
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=24,params=params)
print('embedded',len(ids),flush=True)
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
all_results=[]
for cid in ids:
    c=m.GetConformer(cid)
    # Align the donor triangle to the selected square-planar coordination sites.
    inds=list(anchors)
    src=np.array([list(c.GetAtomPosition(i)) for i in inds])
    target=np.array([anchors[i] for i in inds])
    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd((src-src.mean(0)).T@(target-target.mean(0)))
    rot=u@np.diag([1,1,np.linalg.det(u@vt)])@vt
    xyz=(c.GetPositions()-src.mean(0))@rot+target.mean(0)
    for i in range(m.GetNumAtoms()): c.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(*xyz[i]))
    for i,p in anchors.items(): c.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(*p))
    ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props,confId=cid)
    metal=ff.AddExtraPoint(0.,0.,0.,fixed=True)-1
    for i in anchors: ff.AddFixedPoint(i)
    ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(1,0,12,False,118.,122.,100.)
    for i in (1,12):ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(metal,0,i,False,118.,122.,100.)
    for p in (3,14):
        neigh=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(p).GetNeighbors()]
        for i in neigh:ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(metal,p,i,False,106.,117.,50.)
        for k,i in enumerate(neigh):
            for j in neigh[k+1:]:ff.MMFFAddAngleConstraint(i,p,j,False,102.,114.,25.)
    ff.Initialize()
    ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000)
    # Add simple nonbonded avoidance against Os and the terminal nitride,
    # while retaining the standard ligand force field and donor constraints.
    n=m.GetNumAtoms()
    radii=np.array([1.1 if a.GetSymbol()=='H' else 1.70 if a.GetSymbol()=='C' else 1.6 for a in m.GetAtoms()])
    nitr=np.array([0.,1.66,0.])
    def energy_grad(flat):
        pts=flat.reshape((n+1,3))
        e=ff.CalcEnergy(flat.tolist())
        g=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(flat.tolist())).reshape((n+1,3))
        for center in (np.zeros(3),nitr):
            dif=pts[:n]-center
            dis=np.linalg.norm(dif,axis=1)
            minimum=radii+(1.25 if center[1]==0 else 1.5)
            if center[1]==0:
                minimum[list(anchors)]=0
            gap=np.maximum(minimum-dis,0)
            e+=30.*np.sum(gap**2)
            g[:n]+=-60.*gap[:,None]*dif/dis[:,None]
        return e,g.ravel()
    start=np.vstack((c.GetPositions(),np.zeros(3)))
    bounds=[(None,None)]*(3*(n+1))
    for i,p in anchors.items():
        for j in range(3):bounds[3*i+j]=(p[j],p[j])
    for j in range(3):bounds[3*n+j]=(0.,0.)
    opt=minimize(energy_grad,start.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',bounds=bounds,options={'maxiter':1500,'ftol':1e-10,'gtol':1e-5})
    xyz=opt.x.reshape((n+1,3))[:n]
    print(cid,round(opt.fun,3),opt.success,flush=True)
    all_results.append((opt.fun,xyz))

energy,xyz=min(all_results,key=lambda x:x[0])
symbols=[a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms()]+['Os','N']
xyz=np.vstack((xyz,[0.,0.,0.],[0.,1.66,0.]))
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
    f.write(str(len(symbols))+'\n')
    f.write('Os nitrido complex with bis(di-tert-butylphosphinoethyl)amido pincer; angstrom\n')
    for s,p in zip(symbols,xyz): f.write(f'{s:2s} {p[0]: .8f} {p[1]: .8f} {p[2]: .8f}\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'ligand.mol',confId=ids[0])
print('Saved answer.xyz; selected energy',energy)
PY

cat > check.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
lines=open('answer.xyz').read().splitlines(); syms=[l.split()[0] for l in lines[2:]]; xyz=np.array([[float(v) for v in l.split()[1:]] for l in lines[2:]])
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('[N-](CCP(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C)CCP(C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C'))
print('atoms',len(syms))
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
 d=np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j])
 if syms[i]!='H' and syms[j]!='H':print(i,j,syms[i],syms[j],round(d,3))
for p in (3,14):
 for q in [a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(p).GetNeighbors()]:
  a=xyz[67]-xyz[p]; b=xyz[q]-xyz[p]
  print('Os-P-C',p,q, np.degrees(np.arccos(a@b/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b)))))
print('amide')
for i,j in ((1,12),(1,67),(12,67)):
 a=xyz[i]-xyz[0];b=xyz[j]-xyz[0]
 print(i,j,np.degrees(np.arccos(a@b/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b)))))
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(12,7))
color={'H':'#cccccc','C':'#303030','N':'#2270ee','P':'#ed901b','Os':'#632282'}
bonds=[(b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()) for b in m.GetBonds()]+[(67,0),(67,3),(67,14),(67,68)]
for k,(x,y,title) in enumerate([(0,1,'Molecular plane'),(0,2,'View from nitrido axis')]):
 ax=fig.add_subplot(1,2,k+1)
 for i,j in bonds:
  ax.plot([xyz[i,x],xyz[j,x]],[xyz[i,y],xyz[j,y]],color='#808080',zorder=1,lw=1.2)
 for i,s in enumerate(syms):
  ax.scatter(xyz[i,x],xyz[i,y],s=60 if s!='H' else 18,color=color[s],edgecolors='black',linewidths=.2,zorder=3)
  if s in ['P','N','Os']:ax.text(xyz[i,x]+.06,xyz[i,y]+.06,s,size=11)
 ax.set_aspect('equal');ax.set_title(title)
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('structure_check.png',dpi=140)
